description: Experience the ever-changing beauty of the Banzai Pipeline on Oahu’s North Shore, from world-class winter swells to the most iconic tropical sunsets. Known globally as the "Seven Mile Miracle," this stretch of Hawaiian coastline offers a dual experience. During the winter months, witness the power of the Pacific as legendary surfers tackle massive barrels over the shallow reef. In the off-season, the North Shore transforms into a serene escape, featuring crystal-clear turquoise waters and calming ambient ocean sounds.

title: The Rooftop Bar | Oceanside, CA | San Diego Web Cam
author: San Diego Web Cam
description:
Perched high atop The Rooftop Bar on the sixth floor of the Mission Pacific Beach Resort in Oceanside, California—right at the base of the historic Oceanside Pier—this west-facing webcam delivers breathtaking panoramic views of the Pacific Ocean. Watch surfers catching waves, vibrant sunsets painting the sky, and the iconic pier stretching out into the horizon, with glimpses of Catalina and San Clemente Islands on clear days. Experience the lively coastal vibe, from daytime ocean breezes to evening energy, all in real-time from this premier North San Diego County spot.

Rooftop Bar info: https://www.rooftopbaroceanside.com/

You can go directly to this cam using this URL:  https://rtb.SunDiegoLive.com

Type !ocfishing for current conditions and forecast.
Type !surf for surfing report

CHAT:  No political or religious talk, please.  It's too polarizing.  We want this feed to be enjoyable for everyone.  Keep it family friendly.  You must subscribe to chat.  This is not the same as "JOIN", which is a paid membership to support the channel.  You merely need to "SUBSCRIBE" to chat.  This is to help reduce chat spammers. 

Thank you

=====

Chat Bot Commands:

!ocweather  for Oceanside weather forecast

!surf for the local surf forecast

!tsunami will return local tsunami information

!whois xx

where xx is a ship number.  i.e. !whois 70

Will tell you about warship 70.

!weather - weather report
!fireworks - fireworks schedule

Can play fetch too. Ask Guy to show you.

If you find the bot annoying then block it in your chat feed.  Click to the right of it and block.  You can (and should) block any source in the chat you find annoying.

=====
Members can control our cams and switched feed video via chat commands! 

Not a member?  Click JOIN - only 99 cents/month to support this channel.

=====
Moving the 4K cameras

The seven cameras that can be controlled by members via chat commands are:

SIE : Shelter Island East (Bali Hai Restaurant)
SIP: Shelter Island Pier (Fathom Bistro, Bait & Tackle)
RVN - San Diego Bay East (Mike Hess Brewing)
HIE:  Harbor Island East (Tom Hams Lighthouse)
HIS: Harbor Island South (Tom Hams Lighthouse)
RTB*: Rooftop Bar at Mission Pacific in Oceanside

*THIS CAMERA IS RTB

Commands format:

* * To move the camera * *

!move [cam] [location/direction] [step]

examples: "!move sie buoy21" will point the Shelter Island camera towards buoy 21.

"!move sie up 8"  will move the Shelter Island camera up 8 steps

"!move sis right 3" will move the Shelter Island South camera right 3 steps

You can !move up, down, left, right.  i.e !move hie right 3

* * To zoom the camera * *

!push [cam] [1-25]

examples: "!push sie 25" will zoom IN the Shelter Island 4K camera 25 steps

!pull [cam] [1-25]

examples: "!pull his 5" will zoom OUT the Harbor Island South camera 5 steps


* * * Camera specific locations (!move [cam] [location]):

RTB PRESETS:
*tip - If you want to see a specific location, start from a nearby preset and move up/down/left/right/push/pull from there.


From HIE:

tour (starts the tour)
south: South of pier
pier: Oceanside pier
piersouth: Surfing area just south of the pier
piernorth: Surfing area just north of the pier
piercu: Close up near the lifeguard tower on the pier
farpiercu:  Close up towards the west end of the pier
beach: Beach south of Rooftop Bar
vbg: Vandenberg SFB rocket launch direction
surfing: Current fixed surfing preset
wide: Wide shot

More will be added.

Enjoy!

title: Pacifica Pier and Beach, Pacifica CA 4k Live
author: Chamberlin Nature
description:
Live views of the ocean from the Sharp Park beach area of Pacifica, CA which is about 15min south of San Francisco.  There are four cameras providing different views:

Pacifica Pier View (view to the North)
https://youtube.com/live/QYRIc4LcvqQ

Pacifica Pier Closeup (view to the North, zoomed in more)
https://youtube.com/live/BrUaOjjXgZM

Mori Pt View (view to the South)
https://youtube.com/live/q0Z7tv_7n-0

Sharp Park Beach View (view to the West)
https://youtube.com/live/lmec_rcEIL4

I have a web page which provides three cameras side-by-side in a triptych-style view:  
https://pacificaview.net/livecam/sharp_triptych.php

And there's a web page which provides all four cameras in a quad cam view:
https://pacificaview.net/livecam/sharp_quad_cam.php

There is also a page with embedded versions of each of the views, as well as a bit of additional information about the cameras here:

https://pacificaview.net/livecam/

There is a personal weather station located on the same mast as the web cameras.  You can view the weather information here:

https://pacificaview.net/weather/  

The weather information is also sent to Weather Underground and several other services.  There is more information and links at:

https://pacificaview.net/weather/about/

I take a lot of photographs in and around Pacifica.  If you’re interested in viewing them, you can see them at:

https://chamberlinnature.com/

If you are interested in whales and whale watching in Pacifica, I have a site with forums, guides and other relevant information at:

https://pacificawhales.org/

title: The Marine Mammal Center Live Stream Point Reyes National Seashore
author: The Marine Mammal Center (Livestream Channel)
description:
This channel shares livestream video from Point Reyes National Seashore where The Marine Mammal Center, the world’s largest marine mammal hospital, frequently releases patients back to their ocean home.
 
Sometimes releases happen earlier or later than planned due to factors outside of our control. Missed something good? Rewind the stream up to 12 hours right here on YouTube. Just hover over the video and slide the time bar back.
 
Unpredictable weather conditions can interfere with the stream. If the stream is down, enjoy highlights on our website at https://bit.ly/3SSkcEj or our main channel, @MarineMammalCenter.
 
Text RELEASE to 65179 to get a notification when a patient release is visible from our webcam as well as other stories, news and more. Message and data rates may apply. Text STOP to stop. Terms & Conditions at https://www.MarineMammalCenter.org/terms.
 
To learn more about the Center visit https://MarineMammalCenter.org. To learn more about Point Reyes National Seashore, visit https://www.nps.gov/pore.
